name: Nicole Pexton
occupation: Chief Audit Executive, Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission

bio.statement: Pexton's candidate filing lists her current job as chief audit executive at the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission since 2022.
bio.excerpt: Chief Audit Executive, Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission (2022 to present)

bio.statement: Pexton's filing lists prior auditing roles as senior auditor at Metro and performance auditor at the Secretary of State.
bio.excerpt: Other government auditing experience: Senior Auditor, Metro (2019-2022); Performance Auditor, Secretary of State (2012-2014).

bio.statement: Pexton's voters' pamphlet statement lists a master's in public policy from American University, a B.A. from Whitman College, and internal auditor certifications.
bio.excerpt: American University, M.P.P; Whitman College, B.A.; Certified Internal Auditor, Certification in Risk Management Assurance

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (JCVP-01 voters' pamphlet statement)

bio.statement: Pexton's pamphlet statement lists chairing the Multnomah County Library Bond Oversight Committee and the Department of Early Learning and Care Audit Committee.
bio.excerpt: Chair, Multnomah County Library Bond Oversight Committee; Chair, Department of Early Learning and Care Audit Committee;

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (JCVP-01 voters' pamphlet statement)

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Pexton says she will push for more transparent and accountable county governance.
positions.excerpt: As County Auditor, I will fight for more transparent and accountable governance.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (JCVP-01 voters' pamphlet statement)

positions.statement: Pexton's pamphlet statement says she will shorten the audit process so audits can improve as many services as possible.
positions.excerpt: I will shorten the audit process so our audits can improve as many services as possible.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (JCVP-01 voters' pamphlet statement)

positions.statement: Pexton's pamphlet statement says audit reports will be brief and target key risks with timely solutions.
positions.excerpt: Reports will be brief and target key risks with timely solutions.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (JCVP-01 voters' pamphlet statement)

positions.statement: Pexton's pamphlet statement says she will explore ways for auditors to give proactive support and advice to catch problems early.
positions.excerpt: I will explore ways for auditors to give proactive support and advice, so we can catch problems early.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (JCVP-01 voters' pamphlet statement)

positions.statement: Pexton's pamphlet statement says she wants residents to see results and know their tax dollars are well spent.
positions.excerpt: I want residents to see results; to know their tax dollars are well spent.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (JCVP-01 voters' pamphlet statement)
